positions.description: Backend engineer @ Commerce team (Pay with Venmo)

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
• DATA1030, Introduction to Topics in Data and Computational Science, in Master’s Program (ScM)
• Developed coursework, led sections and held office hours to promote understanding of Data Science.

positions.title: Technical Research Team Leader - UTRA (Undergraduate Teaching and Research Awards)
positions.description:
• Led a project-based cross-functional team comprised of classicists and programmers to make the first comprehensive database of inscriptions produced in the region of Israel/Palestine from around 600 BCE to 600 CE accessible to the public.

• Built the architecture of the new "Inscriptions of Israel/Palestine" web application from a concise wireframe to a fully functional, production-ready application using Python and Django framework.

• Constructed an interactive data map visualization of over 3,500 inscriptions using leaflet.js, geoJSON overlays and Mapbox tiles.

positions.title: Data Science Intern
positions.description:
• Explored foreign currency exchange trades data of 110 trading platforms, developed machine learning models to generate investable trading signals and tracked top performing platforms using Python.

• Examined the market for various applications in the task of user classification in Twitter.

positions.title: Brand Ambassador
positions.description:
• Planned and organized a series of marketing events geared towards increasing the awareness of Uber brand in Korea.

• Developed potential business directives through examining competitors' marketing methods and sales activities and emphasizing Uber's core differentiated qualities.
